subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` flag that lets `--check` ignore info-level findings while still reporting them?
rationale: The patch is additive and proven, but `secrets audit --check` is part of the documented SecretRef migration security gate and CODEOWNERS marks the touched secrets code/docs as security-sensitive.

options.title: Sponsor the current threshold flag
options.body: Merge the current additive flag after security/product owner approval that info-only findings may be visible without failing opt-in automation gates.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Ask for a smaller shape, such as a more explicit check-threshold name or a limited treatment for `LEGACY_RESIDUE`, before merge.

options.title: Defer until cleanup policy exists
options.body: Close or pause this direction if audit gates should keep failing on every finding until OAuth residue cleanup is first-class.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the current threshold flag
recommendation.body: Merge the current additive flag after security/product owner approval that info-only findings may be visible without failing opt-in automation gates.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and expanded the secrets audit flow that this PR changes, making them the best available routing owner for the threshold semantics.
